The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations. What You’ll Do (Impact Areas) Data Analysis & Business Insights Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness. Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. What Success Looks Like Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Required What You Bring (Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants. Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations. Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products. Work Model & Travel Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements. Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization. Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs. Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams. Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products. Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions. Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders. A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact. Title: INGENIERO DE AUTOMATIZACION Y OPTIMIZACION DE PROCESOS
Description: Descripción del puesto Asegurar la confiabilidad, disponibilidad, desempeño y ciberseguridad de los sistemas de automatización y control, integrando la optimización de lazos PID, la gestión de alarmas y respaldos, y el Control Estadístico de Procesos (SPC) para reducir la variabilidad y mejorar la estabilidad, calidad y eficiencia operacional, en coordinación con Mantenimiento y Proceso. Principales responsabilidades Evaluar de manera sistemática el desempeño de los sistemas de control de las plantas, con énfasis en la estabilidad, respuesta y desempeño de los lazos PID, identificando oportunidades de optimización y ejecutando o coordinando su sintonía. Depurar y mejorar el sistema de alarmas de control, promoviendo alarmas útiles, oportunas y accionables, así como el seguimiento de planes de reducción de alarmas recurrentes. Asegurar la disponibilidad e integridad de los respaldos de PLC, HMI, SCADA/DCS y demás plataformas de automatización, dando seguimiento a su ejecución, almacenamiento y recuperación. Desarrollar, actualizar y estandarizar procedimientos de mantenimiento, diagnóstico y recuperación de los sistemas de control, en coordinación con las plantas y Soporte Técnico. Mantener los accesos remotos a los sistemas de control y plataformas asociadas, asegurando su correcta operación y cumplimiento con las iniciativas y lineamientos de ciberseguridad industrial/OT de la compañía. Participar en análisis de causa raíz (RCA), proyectos de mejora y estandarización tecnológica, aportando análisis técnico y seguimiento a las acciones definidas. Implementar y mantener estrategias de Control Estadístico de Procesos (SPC), analizando variabilidad, capacidad y tendencias de variables críticas para detectar desviaciones tempranas y coordinar oportunidades de mejora. Retos del puesto Confiabilidad, estabilidad y reducción de variabilidad. Adopción de estándares PID, alarmas, respaldos y SPC. Habilidades y conocimientos requeridos Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas. Capacidad para realizar análisis de causa raíz. Toma de decisiones basada en datos. Planeación, organización y seguimiento de actividades. Orientación a resultados y mejora continua. Comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos y niveles gerenciales. Trabajo colaborativo con las áreas de Mantenimiento, Proceso, Ingeniería e IT/OT. Autonomía, iniciativa y capacidad de ejecución. Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo. Atención al detalle y enfoque en confiabilidad operacional. Formación académica sugerida Ingeniería: Electrónica, Automatización, Control, Mecatrónica o afín. Inglés: Intermedio – Avanzado (B2). Experiencia requerida Conocimientos de automatización, control de procesos, instrumentación o mantenimiento de sistemas de control industrial. Conocimiento en diagnóstico y sintonía de lazos PID, sistemas de alarmas y plataformas PLC/SCADA/DCS. Experiencia en ambientes industriales y trabajo directo con equipos de planta, mantenimiento y proceso. Experiencia en análisis de variabilidad, estabilidad y capacidad de procesos mediante SPC. Conocimiento requerido Control de procesos y teoría/sintonía PID. PLC, HMI, SCADA/DCS y arquitecturas de sistemas de control. Redes industriales y comunicaciones OT. Gestión de alarmas, respaldos, control de versiones y recuperación de sistemas. Ciberseguridad industrial, accesos remotos y buenas prácticas en ambientes OT. Instrumentación industrial y análisis de datos de proceso. Control Estadístico de Procesos (SPC), cartas de control y análisis de causas especiales. Índices de capacidad y desempeño de proceso: Cp, Cpk, Pp y Ppk. Herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos industriales, como Minitab, Power BI, Python o equivalentes. Competencias críticas Análisis de fallas y problemas complejos. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a datos. Toma de decisiones oportuna. Planificación y seguimiento. Empuje para tener resultados. Comunicación y comodidad con altos mandos. Integridad, confianza y autosuficiencia. Relaciones Internas: Gerente de Soporte Técnico: Definir prioridades, estrategia técnica, estándares y planes de mejora para automatización y control; reportar avances, riesgos y resultados. Coordinadores de Mantenimiento Eléctrico: Evaluar sistemas de control, priorizar oportunidades, coordinar actividades, respaldos, procedimientos y solución de problemas. Gerencias de Mantenimiento y Proceso: Alinear necesidades operativas y priorizar optimizacion de proceso, desempeno PID, reduccion de alarmas y aplicacion de SPC en variables criticas, incluyendo seguimiento de desviaciones y acciones de mejora. IT / Ciberseguridad / OT: Mantener accesos remotos y conectividad segura de los sistemas de control, atendiendo lineamientos, controles y requerimientos de seguridad. Proyectos / Ingeniería: Definir y revisar aspectos tecnicos de automatizacion, arquitectura de control, integración y estandarización en proyectos OPEX/CAPEX. Externas: Fabricantes / proveedores de automatización: Soporte técnico especializado, diagnóstico de fallas, actualización de plataformas, validación de soluciones y definición de alcances de servicio. Proveedores de ciberseguridad / conectividad industrial: Soporte a accesos remotos, controles de seguridad, conectividad y cumplimiento de requerimientos para ambientes OT. Description: About Carrier Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure the safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. About The Role The Systems Modeling Engineer will develop and maintain performance models and calculation engines for water‑cooled chiller systems. This role focuses on engineering calculations and numerical model implementation, supporting system performance calculations for water-cooled chillers. The successful candidate will apply strong fundamentals in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and numerical methods to develop, validate, and optimize HVAC/R system models, working closely with global engineering and product teams. If this is you, get in touch. As a Minimum You Must Have University Degree or equivalent A minimum of 7 years prior relevant experience or an advanced degree in a related field and a minimum of 5 years' experience. Strong fundamentals in: Heat transfer Thermodynamics Numerical methods Nonlinear equation systems Experience with thermal-fluid system modeling Hands-on programming experience in Fortran and C# (preferred) or similar numerical languages (C/C++, Java) Experience developing or maintaining engineering calculation models or simulation tools Experience in HVAC/R, power systems, or related equipment domain Demonstrated ability to lead technical efforts or define modeling / calculation approaches for complex engineering systems Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to collaborate across global, cross-functional teams Ability to work independently on technical problems while contributing to team objectives Although not necessary, it would be nice if you have: Experience maintaining legacy engineering calculation codebases Experience developing multi-language solutions across modeling and software systems Familiarity with optimization techniques or product configuration tools Experience mentoring or guiding junior engineers Benefits We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Title: Associate Director
Description: Associate Director – Corporates, Infrastructure and Project Finance Ratings - Mexico The Fitch Ratings Corporates, Infrastructure and Project Finance group is currently seeking an Associate Director for coverage of the Industrials sector based out of our Mexico City or Monterrey office. Qualitative credentials will weigh meaningfully in the selection of the candidate. A healthy sense of intellectual curiosity is critical, along with a willingness and ability to attack and explain topics of analytical complexity. Fitch is a team-oriented work environment, so excellent communication skills are essential, as is a high productivity work-ethic and results oriented mindset. What We Offer An opportunity to be a lead coverage analyst in the LATAM Industrials team at a global rating agency. A team-oriented work environment. Fitch Ratings is a global company with a presence in over 30 countries, offering opportunities to work with diverse teams and clients from around the world. We’ll Count On You To Perform analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing the credit quality of companies in the LATAM Industrials team. Develop and maintain comprehensive financial models. Present analysis of companies to internal credit rating committees. Conduct meetings with LATAM Industrials management teams in different sectors. Involvement in communicating rating rationale to external audiences (primarily institutional investors, sell-side analysts and media) in meetings, conference calls, press releases and written research reports. Write timely and effective research on topical issues. Participate in the evaluation of other credits within the Industrial team, as well as other related credit groups. Represent Fitch in panel discussions and conferences arranged by industry associations, regulatory bodies etc. Mentor junior members of the LATAM Industrials team. Participate in meetings with Industrials executive-level management teams to strengthen understanding of their business and industry. What You Need To Have Bachelor's degree at minimum, MBA or other advanced degree a plus; 5+ years of relevant experience, which must include some coverage or knowledge of the Industrials sector; Capital markets and/or credit analysis experience a plus; Strong analytical, quantitative, and organizational skills; Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Ability to shift fluidly between multiple projects as priorities change; Ability to excel in a team-oriented environment; Advanced English proficiency (verbal and written); Native Spanish speaker or advanced Spanish proficiency (verbal and written); Expertise in Excel and Word; CFA candidate preferred, CFA/CPA a plus. What Would Make You Stand Out A deep understanding of and a keen interest in the Automotive, Building Materials and Products, Diversified Manufacturing and Chemical sectors; A professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis and well-developed financial statement analysis and modeling skills; A strong pattern of leadership and the ability to proactively and successfully interact with various stakeholders, both within and outside of the organization. Why Fitch? Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required. A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity. Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies. Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe. Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community. At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone. Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority. We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey. Fitch group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.
